answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, and tie that deposit to one identity whose work history forms a single unbroken thread: each completed job adds a signed receipt, so reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. A fresh identity starts in the umber shadows with zero trust and tiny limits, earning larger jobs only by doing real work over time. An attacker spawning a whisper of a thousand fake agents must fund each one and wait months for trust to grow, so the attack costs more than any reward it could steal.
